prerequisites: Basic understanding of elementary probability theory, algorithms, and complexity.
Basic understanding of cryptography is also helpful.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the basics of consensus algorithms.
Learn the types of models used to model these algorithms.
Quantify the correctness, security, and liveness properties of consensus algorithms.
Understand the efficiency metrics used to quantify the performance and robustness of consensus algorithms.
Become familiar with techniques to prove that achieving consensus is impossible under certain conditions.
Gain a comprehensive overview of classical (and some newer) results in the field.
Be able to write a Bachelor's or Master's thesis on this topic and read/understand the latest results from the literature.

syllabus_topics: Distributed consensus as the fundamental problem of reaching agreement over a point-to-point network.
Important results in the field of distributed consensus.
Newer developments driven by the blockchain era.
High-performance algorithms scalable to billions of users.
assessment_rules: To receive credits, the exam must be passed.
